definitions.explanation: To fasten, attach, or apply something to something else. The transitive pair of {付|つ}く (to stick to).
To switch on electrical devices. Written as {点|つ}ける for this meaning. Opposite of {消|け}す (to turn off).

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}を{点|つ}けてください。
{名前|なまえ}を{付|つ}けました。
examples.notes: 名前を付ける = to name

examples.japanese: テレビを{点|つ}けてもいいですか。
examples.english: May I turn on the TV?

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {付|つ}く (intransitive). Pattern: Xを{付|つ}ける (attach X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {付|つ}けている = 'have attached' or 'is wearing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{名前|なまえ}を{付|つ}ける (give a name)
・{電気|でんき}を{点|つ}ける (turn on light)
・{気|き}を{付|つ}ける (be careful)
・マークを{付|つ}ける (put a mark)

PAIR: {付|つ}く (intransitive) - {汚|よご}れが{付|つ}いた (dirt stuck). Multiple kanji: {付|つ}ける (attach), {点|つ}ける (turn on).
